as_told.title: Elizondo says he has seen the Big Sur video

plain: A secret film said to show a UFO shooting down a dummy nuclear warhead during a missile test off Big Sur, on the California coast, in the 1960s is said to have been seen by Lue Elizondo, a former Pentagon official who ran a small office that studied unexplained aerial reports. A researcher of UFO sightings at nuclear bases named Robert Hastings gives the fullest version. He says a Senate staffer named Kurt McConnell emailed him to say he had driven Elizondo to his interview with AARO, the Pentagon's current UFO office. On the way back, McConnell wrote, Elizondo said he had told Sean Kirkpatrick, the head of that office, that he had seen the Big Sur film. Michels repeats the core of it twice, simply saying Elizondo says he has seen the video, without the drive or Kirkpatrick. Every teller is passing on what Elizondo is said to have said. If true, it would mean the film still exists inside the government and that officials were told about it.
